name: Microwave Bean Burrito Bowl
ingredients: 1 cup cooked black or pinto beans
1 tsp cumin and ½ tsp smoked paprika
steps: Mix the beans, corn, cumin, paprika and salt in a bowl; cover and microwave for 2 minutes.
Warm the rice for 1 minute with a splash of water.
Divide the rice and lettuce between two bowls.
Top with the beans, tomato, onion and avocado.
Finish with lime juice, salsa and coriander.
note: A five-minute assembly meal built from pantry staples.
